reviews.review: This game was never what we wanted it to be, just re download Left 4 Dead 2.

This is a very, very good game. I have played this with both friends and family, and yes, while not all of it is balanced or entirely fair, it is ultimately are very entertaining experience. Even when playing by myself (having completed the campaign at least 5 times) I have enjoyed myself going through it all.

I'll break down what I like, first:

__Zombie Design__
This is, without a doubt, my favorite aspect of this game, and far exceeds it's previous adaption, with the exception of perhaps the Smoker from L4D. Every mutation has a "weakspot" which is glowing an easy to identify, which is extra helpful. The Reeker (and Cultists from the DLC) are an exception, but you can usually default to headshots or wherever they do not have armor. It's noticably rewarding to hit them there, too.

__Environmental Design/Artstyle__
It is a very visually appealing game, and I think nearly every level has something memorable in this regard. When replaying certain levels, there's always a part where you think "Oh I remember this" which is reminiscent of memorable design. Boats, Bridges, Libraries, Mines, Tunnels, etc. Good stuff.

__Corruption Cards__
This is cool. Each level, you have the chance of fighting something new or playing in a mildly different way. This usually doesn't ruin the experience, and I think it's way better now. (I was told it used to be super unbalanced.) This will change basic zombies, mutations, zombie hordes, environmental hazards supplies, and bosses. I love the bosses.

Now, obviously (as many people have a hate boner for this game) it's not perfect, I will go over what sticks out to me.

__Story/Characters__
The Dialogue and Story in this game is kind of bad, with the exception of Prophet Dan and maybe Jim, but that's not really why people play this game. There's a far better emphasis on the gameplay, which is exactly what it should be. It's funny to mock the character's speaking sometimes, my friends do it a lot.

__Snipers__
Snipers don't really fit into this game, I've played each class every time and sniper usually doesn't do very well. This is probably on account of the condensed level design, which is usually fine with other guns. The game is pretty linear which is great for new people getting around.

People will tell you bad things about this game, but a lot of it, to me, is very dismissive and not sincere. To be clear, this is NOT Left 4 Dead. The experience, all around, is better, more clear, and far less painful. This will always be one of my favorite games. Case closed.
Great game. Just the successor to Left 4 Dead 2 I wanted to see.
